[@sakaladev/usai](/docs/sdk/) / [index](/docs/sdk/index/) / TypedWorkload



A [Workload](/docs/sdk/index/interfaces/workload/) that remembers what its handler returns, so
`ctx.tasks.invoke(thatTask)` is typed instead of `unknown`. The parameter
is a phantom: nothing carries it at runtime, and a `TypedWorkload` is a
`Workload` everywhere one is expected.

## Extends

- [`Workload`](/docs/sdk/index/interfaces/workload/)

## Type Parameters

| Type Parameter | Default type |
| ------ | ------ |
| `Out` | `unknown` |
| `In` | `unknown` |
